# Summernote (vendor)

This folder is intended to hold the official Summernote distribution files if you prefer serving them locally instead of from CDN.

Files to copy here (example):

- `summernote-bs4.min.js` (official minified JS)
- `lang/summernote-zh-CN.min.js` (language file)
- Optionally other plugins or CSS if you prefer local hosting.

To enable full local Summernote, copy the official `summernote-bs4.min.js` into this directory (overwriting the placeholder) and the templates will pick it up automatically.
